description: This file defines the CreditsRepository class with static methods for managing credit balances, expense logs, and purchase logs using Prisma ORM in a TypeScript project.

classes.name: CreditsRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing static methods for credit balance and expense log operations.

methods.name: findCreditBalance
methods.description: Finds credit balance by teamId or userId.

methods.name: findCreditExpenseLogByExternalRef
methods.description: Retrieves a credit expense log by external reference.

methods.name: findCreditBalanceWithTeamOrUser
methods.description: Finds credit balance with associated team or user details.

methods.name: findCreditBalanceWithExpenseLogs
methods.description: Retrieves credit balance along with expense logs within a date range.

methods.name: updateCreditBalance
methods.description: Updates credit balance record by id, teamId, or userId.

methods.name: createCreditBalance
methods.description: Creates a new credit balance record.

methods.name: createCreditExpenseLog
methods.description: Creates a new credit expense log, handling duplicate external references.

methods.name: createCreditPurchaseLog
methods.description: Creates a new credit purchase log.
